data.explanation: This is your landlord's yearly settlement of the building's running costs (Betriebskosten) for 2025. Your actual share came to more than what you had already paid in advance, so you owe €263.18 more. Pay this amount to the landlord's account by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from when you received this letter. There is no stated process to formally object in this letter, but you can check the attached itemised breakdown (Einzelaufstellung) and contact the management if any cost item looks wrong before paying.
